about: Victoriaville is the principal city of the Bois-Francs in Centre-du-Québec, inland from the St. Lawrence between Montréal and Québec City. It grew around furniture and woodworking and now includes the former town of Arthabaska. A compact downtown, exhibition grounds, and a well-known experimental-music festival shape civic life. About 48,000 people live in Victoriaville.
seoSummary: Bois-Francs city in Centre-du-Québec, known for furniture-making and the FIMAV music festival.
